verdict.rationale: Dagster supports some bulk operations (wiping/deleting dynamic partitions in a single action for multi-partitioned assets, running subsets of dbt models via UI/APIs) and exposes a Dagster+ MCP server that lets an AI session 'take actions' in a deployment, but there is no explicit documentation showing an AI agent performing bulk operations across many assets/runs/partitions via the MCP server or CLI. Missing for 10: concrete AI-native bulk-action examples (e.g., agent triggering multi-asset backfills or bulk re-runs), independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk operation support through AI tooling.
